summary: Newton County lookout listed as 'covington' at 885 ft; a 2026 RepeaterBook listing names a Newton County Forestry Fire Tower at Covington as a radio repeater site. No build or history source found.

facts.status_note: Inferred from a 2026 repeater listing that names a Newton County Forestry Fire Tower as the site. No source describes the tower's condition.

corrections.why: The list gives the code as BLL-50789 with no US prefix. Format point for the editor; the list does not state a country for this code.
The list gives the code as gfc-411 with no US prefix. Same format point as the Adel and Currahee records.

notes_for_editor: Only current-state source is a RepeaterBook amateur radio listing (updated 2026-01-14) that names a 'Newton County Forestry Fire Tower' as the site. Linking it to the tnlandforms 'covington' entry rests on the county and the name; the listing text gives no coordinates. The list's name and county match the listing, but that does not prove identity. No build, staffing or fate source found after two searches and reads. The 'standing' status is an inference; set to unknown if you want a stricter record. Do not confuse with us-ga-newton (Newton Firetower, Mitchell County, a different tower).
